data.name: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
data.detailed_description:
Playtest is now available and includes the first 3 days of the story (the full version will include 12 days of story).

See Appendix for the correspondence between the number of days and episodes.

Game Features

  • Automatic saving for each episode, no manual saving required.

  • You can freely jump between each episode.

  • The main character's name can be changed. She has no preset appearance.

  • A total of 4 endings: 2 bad endings, 1 normal ending, and 1 good ending.

  • Approximate wordcount is 40000.

  • A positive theme of fighting crime and saving handsome guys.

  • Several mini games are included in the story.

  • A humorous side DLC will be released after completing the main story.

Disclaimer and Content Warning

All characters in this game are 18 years of age or older.

This game does not contain any explicit pornographic content, nudity, or depictions of sexual acts. It does mention sexual abuse and attempted sexual assault (without visual or explicit depictions).

This game is purely fictional. All names, places, events, companies, or organizations appearing in the game have no connection to the real world. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental.

The game contains multiple branches and endings; some choices may lead the protagonist to moral depravity.

The themes of this game are [Trauma, Power, and Redemption]. The depiction of evil does not imply that the development team endorses or encourages any exploitation, abuse, or illegal activities. In real life, please adhere to legal boundaries and moral principles.

If you experience severe psychological discomfort while playing, please close the game immediately.

Appendix

The tentative correspondence between the number of days and chapters. Might be slightly adjusted later. The number of episodes and text volume varies for each day. There is a total of 12 days of story.

data.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!
